title: ML-based Physical Design Parameter Optimization for 3D ICs: From Parameter Selection to Optimization
problem: Physical design parameter optimization in 3D integrated circuits lacks systematic exploration and comprehensive methodology. Designers must manually select and optimize numerous parameters across multiple conflicting objectives.
motivation: Automated ML-based parameter optimization can improve design quality and reduce design cycle time for 3D IC technologies.
method: End-to-end ML framework that automatically performs parameter selection and optimization without human intervention. Evaluated against five state-of-the-art parameter optimization techniques on six industrial 3D IC designs using TSMC 28nm technology node, optimizing across three different design objectives.
key_novelty: First end-to-end ML framework for combined automatic parameter selection and optimization in 3D IC physical design.
contributions: Comprehensive qualitative and quantitative comparison of five SOTA parameter optimization techniques for 3D ICs
ML-based end-to-end framework for automatic parameter selection and optimization without human intervention
Validation on six industrial 3D IC designs demonstrating superior optimization quality and runtime
Multi-objective optimization results across three different design objectives

metrics.other: optimization quality improvement across three objectives

limitations: Evaluation limited to TSMC 28nm technology node; generalization to other process nodes and design scenarios not discussed.
primary_theme: ML-based parameter optimization for 3D IC physical design
